Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone full-body character concept PNG, 1024x1536 portrait, genuine transparent RGBA background (alpha 0 outside the silhouette, including between legs and between arm and torso). Image 1 is a character-design reference ONLY: Joker/Ren Amamiya's unmasked face, tousled fluffy wavy black hair, pale skin and grey eyes. Do not copy its red background, composition, hand gesture or implied art style. Image 2 is the authoritative COSTUME reference ONLY, not a 3D-render style target. Draw one Joker in his phantom thief costume with NO MASK, no eyewear, face fully exposed: long black swallowtail coat with high standing collar and split tails below the knees; dark grey waistcoat with a vertical row of buttons and a small WHITE pocket square in his LEFT chest pocket; red gloves; dark trousers; BROWN ankle boots. Exact costume proportions and details from image 2. Full body from hair tips through both entire boot soles must be visible, with at least 60 pixels of completely transparent margin on every side (aim for 80px). Body turned THREE-QUARTER TOWARDS SCREEN RIGHT; nose and chest orient toward the right edge, enemy would be on his right. Neutral relaxed standing base pose: farther hand tucked into the coat pocket, nearer arm hanging naturally away from his torso with an obvious open gap; visible hand anatomically clean with five normal fingers including thumb, relaxed fingers; legs slightly apart, knees do not overlap; calm confident expression, very slight smile. EMPTY HANDS, no weapon. No text, labels, signature, watermark, ground, cast shadow, background, halo or glow. This is an original 2D drawn style candidate, not a rendered model. Preserve alpha, no green/white/grey backdrop and no painted checkerboard.
Style A: Persona 5 Royal official character art style (Shigenori Soejima): flat cel shading with large solid black shadow shapes, sharp angular shadow edges, high contrast, thin clean ink lines, limited palette of black, red and white, pale skin. Keep the specified brown boots and grey vest even in the limited palette.
Independent candidate A_1.
